description: Reads integrated loudness (LUFS), sample peak, length, sample rate and stereo correlation straight from the file; nothing is rendered. Costs nothing and takes a few seconds. True peak and loudness range are not part of this quick read: they are measured on a rendered result and returned by get_job.

audio_url.description: Track address as a public https link: a direct file (wav, mp3, flac, m4a) or a sharing link, which the server opens for you.

name: analyze_track

true_peak_db.description: null in the fast pass; see get_job for the measured value

title: Quick loudness reading
